title: 試卷 A｜歷屆精選文法題

questions.question: Maggie _______ go to her swimming class yesterday because she had a headache.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示過去時間，助動詞用 didn't。

questions.question:
Irene: _______ is the clock on the wall?
Nick: Three hundred fifty dollars. It's on sale now.
questions.explanation: 回答金額（三百五十元），問「多少錢」用 How much。

questions.question:
Bob: Mom, I'm hungry. May I have the bread on the table?
Mom: Sure. Just leave _______ for your sister.
questions.explanation: bread 為不可數名詞，「留一些給妹妹」用 some；a few 和 many 只接可數複數名詞。

questions.question: Let's eat out this evening. There _______ any food in the refrigerator.
questions.explanation: food 為不可數名詞，否定用 isn't；any 用於否定句與疑問句。

questions.question:
Sandy: Look! The water in this lake is so clear. It is the most beautiful lake in our town.
Max: Yes, _______ full of beautiful fish.
questions.explanation: 代替前句的 the lake（單數），用代名詞 it is。

questions.question: We have to hurry up, _______ we are sure to miss part of the game.
questions.explanation: 「我們得快點，否則一定會錯過比賽」，or 表「否則」（= or else）。

questions.question: Hank had to prepare for an important report, so he didn't go to bed _______ it was 12 o'clock last night.
questions.explanation: didn't... until 表「直到……才……」，即直到 12 點才去睡。

questions.question: _______ it's already November, people in Kaohsiung are still wearing shorts and T-shirts. It is strange weather.
questions.explanation: 已是 11 月卻仍穿短袖，前後語意對比，用 Though（雖然）。

questions.question: There _______ a bottle of juice in the refrigerator. After you drink some, put it back.
questions.explanation: a bottle of juice 視為單數名詞，用 There is。

questions.question: _______ seven cats at the same time is not an easy job. How can John do that?
questions.explanation: 動名詞 Keeping 作主詞，表示「同時照顧七隻貓」這件事。

questions.question: Mona saw a man _______ her sister's money, so she shouted at him right away.
questions.explanation: see + 受詞 + V-ing，表示「看到某人正在做某事」，用現在分詞。

questions.question: Both movies are good, but I'll choose the funny one over _______ because I could use some laugh after a long day like this.
questions.explanation: 兩部電影二選一，「另一部」用 the other。

questions.question: A-mei is my favorite singer in Taiwan. In my mind, there is no other singer sings _______ her in this country.
questions.explanation: 比較級句型：better than，表示「唱得比她好」。

questions.question:
Simon: How much time do you need to get ready?
Nancy: _______ twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: 回答「大約需要幾分鐘」，用 About（大約）。

questions.question: In this country, people celebrate New Year _______ December 25th to January 5th. Stores and schools are close these days.
questions.explanation: 「從……到……」的固定搭配為 from...to...。

questions.question: Tina put a fan in her room to keep cool, but Mark _______. He used cold drinks to cool down.
questions.explanation: 對應前句過去式 put，否定助動詞用 didn't。

questions.question:
Cindy: How many countries _______?
Jim: Ten. I spent a lot of money taking trips when I was young.
questions.explanation: have been to 表「曾去過（已回來）」；gone to 表「去了（尚未回來）」，此處問曾拜訪過的國家數用 have been to。

questions.question: Look! Here _______! We had better be quiet.
questions.explanation: Here 開頭的倒裝句型：Here + V + 名詞主詞，故用 comes the teacher。

questions.question: Ben has got a new pair of glasses. His glasses are more expensive than _______.
questions.explanation: mine = my glasses，作比較的對象，避免重複使用名詞。

questions.question: No one knows _______ Peter will come. We don't have his phone number.
questions.explanation: 「不知道彼得是否會來」，用 if 引導名詞子句，表示「是否」。

questions.question: My mom cut my hair short yesterday. I really like _______ change.
questions.explanation: 指前文提到的那個特定「改變」，用定冠詞 the。

questions.question: I still haven't quite finished with your notes yet. Can I borrow them for _______ more days?
questions.explanation: days 為可數複數名詞，「再幾天」用 a few；a little 和 much 修飾不可數名詞。

questions.question: I have no idea _______ you are talking about. Is the girl Susan?
questions.explanation: 「不知道你在說什麼」，間接問句 what you are talking about（what 作受詞）。

questions.question: Zoe has to do the dishes every day, but her sister _______.
questions.explanation: her sister 為第三人稱單數，否定用 doesn't（= doesn't have to，省略 have to）。

questions.question: I have made up my mind. Whether Jimmy _______ tomorrow or not, we will hold a party.
questions.explanation: whether 引導的副詞子句，表未來時間用現在式動詞 comes。

questions.question: Molly had an important meeting this morning, but she missed the bus. She was worried. Luckily, her friend picked her up and she got to the office just _______.
questions.explanation: in time 表「及時、剛好趕上」；in no time 表「立刻、馬上」，語意不符。

questions.question: It is so terrible to see the bird _______ by the hunter. How could he do this?
questions.explanation: see + 受詞 + 過去分詞，表示受詞被動承受動作（鳥被殺死）。

questions.question:
Clerk: Would you like milk or sugar in your coffee, sir?
Sean: _______, please.
questions.explanation: 牛奶和糖「兩樣都要」，用 Both。

questions.question: The movie starts at _______. Hurry up, or we will be late.
questions.explanation: half past ten（十點半）是正確的時間說法；five sixty（5:60）不存在，thirty（三十）不完整。

questions.question:
Ed: We are in the museum now. _______ talk loudly.
Sophia: Yes. If we do so, others won't feel comfortable.
questions.explanation: 否定的 Let's 句型為 Let's not + 原形動詞，表「我們不要……」。

questions.question: I am happy to live in Fun Town. The Lover River runs _______ our town, and we can see a lot of fish swimming in the clean water.
questions.explanation: 河流「穿越」城鎮，用 through。

questions.question: Sophie enjoyed showing off the watch _______ her husband gave her as her birthday gift though it was not expensive.
questions.explanation: 修飾物品（the watch）的關係代名詞用 that 或 which。

questions.question: It _______ me two hours to drive from my house to the office every day, so I'm always tired when I arrive home from work.
questions.explanation: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V，為「花費時間」的固定句型。

questions.question: Tell Mr. Lu I can't take the call right now and _______ him call me back in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: have + 受詞 + 原形動詞，使役動詞結構，不需要加 to；ask / tell / get 後需接 to V。

questions.question: Hank thought he put all the pens in the box. However, he found _______ on the chair when he stood up.
questions.explanation: 泛指「一支」筆，不特指某支，用不定代名詞 one。

questions.question: It is kind of the Lins _______ the poor children who cannot see or walk.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + of + 人 + to V，固定句型，用來評論某人的行為。

questions.question: _______ at by strangers always makes me feel terrible.
questions.explanation: 「被陌生人盯著看」為被動語態的動名詞 Being looked at，作主詞。

questions.question: The news is _______ true. All of the people can't believe the news.

options.D: so good that it can be

questions.explanation: too...to... 表「太……而不能……」，too good to be true 為固定片語（好得令人難以置信）。

questions.question: Sally _______ clothes on the balcony when the phone rang, so she didn't hear it.
questions.explanation: when the phone rang 為過去某時點，Sally 正在晾衣服，用過去進行式 was hanging。
